name: What are the common signs that my home's siding needs to be stripped and replaced?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that my home's siding needs to be stripped and replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several indicators suggest your siding may need stripping and replacement. Visible signs include cracking, warping, peeling paint, or excessive fading, which indicate material degradation. You might also notice increased energy bills, suggesting compromised insulation due to damaged siding. Water stains on interior walls or the presence of mold/mildew on the exterior can point to moisture penetration. If your siding is old and showing widespread deterioration, it's often more cost-effective to strip and replace rather than repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs your siding needs stripping and replacement include cracking, warping, peeling paint, increased energy bills, and water stains or mold on walls.
